correctness.rationale: The frozen proof conditions on marked Bernoulli root attachments and derives the correct affine mean recursion u_j=[1+(1-x_j)/(j-2)]u_{j-1}+1 at marked j and [1+1/(j-1)]u_{j-1}+1 elsewhere. The independent Bernoulli mixed-difference identity E[f(A) product(A_i-p_i)]=product p_i(1-p_i) Delta_{t1}...Delta_{tk}f is exact for multiaffine conditional means. The earliest marked time produces -(t1-1)(H_{t1-1}-1)/(t1-2); each later marked time inserts a factor -1/(tj-2) and growth intervals telescope to n/tk. Multiplying Bernoulli variances yields the boxed all-order product. Positivity of H_{t1-1}-1 fixes (-1)^k for all distinct times and k. Independent exhaustive enumerations of every legal parent sequence and all marked subsets for n=3,...,7 reproduce the exact rational mixed moments; these finite checks are corroborative, while the recurrence proof covers all n.

originality.rationale: Previously published Resultary 2026-10-04 states the exact k=1 covariance -n(H_{j-1}-1)/(j(j-1)) and stronger single-root forced-attachment stochastic order. That first-order subcase is expressly not a novel finding here. The new final claim is a strict, factorized all-order mixed product for every k>=2 and all marked time tuples, including odd/even sign reversal. Gałązka/Wdowicka arXiv:2610.00614 Theorem 5.2 supplies a linear martingale-innovation decomposition for path length, not the all-order products against independent root-edge Bernoulli indicators; their theorem alone does not supply the stated higher mixed moments. Earlier joint tree-profile theory was also checked at the statement level.
residual_risks: The arbitrary-order identity might be encoded as mixed derivatives of an older joint attachment/path-length generating function not indexed under these words.
All k1 formulas and consequences are previously published; novelty and value are confined to universal k>=2 factorization/sign hierarchy.

value.rationale: Root attachment times and total path length are canonical observable statistics of uniform recursive trees. Complete higher-order interaction signs clarify genuinely non-additive dependence: all negative first-order contributions coexist with positive second-order, negative third-order and so on, with exact factorization for arbitrarily large marked sets. A natural full hierarchy is useful beyond a one-time covariance and is not a renaming of the prior k=1 formula.

limitations: Distinct marked times, standard independent uniform parent choices; not nonuniform weighted models.
Centred product moments do not imply stochastic order or causality under arbitrary interventions.
